cohort: The study included 60 discarded placentas and umbilical cords collected from deliveries, comprising 30 from low birth weight babies and 30 from normal birth weight babies.
finding: Maternal factors such as age, low socioeconomic status, educational status, and haemoglobin level were significantly associated with low birth weight, and approximate birth weight can be calculated using maternal haemoglobin levels.
birth_weight: Babies with birth weight <2500gms (low birth weight) and babies with birth weight >=2500gms (normal birth weight)
